name: Scan Line
description: A gradient sweep travels across a thin bar from left to right, then resets and repeats

variations.name: default
variations.description: A glowing gradient segment — bright at the leading edge, fading behind — sweeps across a faint track and resets

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the bar in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Thickness of the bar in pixels

props.name: trailLength
props.description: Length of the gradient segment in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
